key_highlights: ASX treads water amid persistent interest rate fears; RBA Governor Bullock's hawkish stance reinforces 'higher for longer' narrative
Iron ore downside pressure persists, weighing on BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; China economic cracks add demand risk
Sydney housing market under severe stress with auction reality check; diesel/petrol price shock compounds cost-of-living pressure
Active WA/SA gold exploration pipeline (Platina, Broken Hill, Great Southern, Forrestania, Larvotto) signals sector rotation into precious metals
Chevron and ExxonMobil double down on LNG capex; Chevron CEO flags oil price/economy concerns
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; government-backed digital pension scheme proposed as parallel to compulsory super
Trump-Xi summit anticipation lifts global equities; oil falls on supply optimism; consumer weakness flagged by Dollar General CEO
Intergenerational Report criticised for overstating productivity growth; Tasmanian government job cuts signal fiscal tightening

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces structural downside with China demand weakening; gold exploration activity robust across WA/SA; rare earths (Dalaroo) and antimony (Larvotto) gaining traction
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from iron ore weakness; gold juniors (Platina, Great Southern, Forrestania, Broken Hill) attract speculative flows; Dalaroo rare earths offer diversification

sectors.trend: Hawkish RBA (Bullock) supports net interest margins but housing stress and rising fuel costs threaten credit quality; super contribution surge boosts fund managers
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from rate environment but face NPL risk from housing downturn; super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) see AUM tailwinds from 33%+ contribution surge

sectors.trend: Chevron/ExxonMobil LNG capex signals long-term demand; oil falls pre-Trump-Xi summit; diesel/petrol price shock hits domestic consumers
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX benefit from LNG investment cycle; fuel price shock pressures consumer discretionary and transport; EV adoption accelerating as Australians flee bowser

sectors.trend: Consumer weakness flagged (Dollar General CEO, Christmas retailer Chapter 11); Sydney housing bloodbath and auction reality check hit property sentiment
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by housing downturn; defensive staples preferred

sectors.trend: NDIS funding failures highlight system gaps; AI integration in markets (Trump-Xi AI summit); Crispin Odey fall signals hedge fund risk
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX remain defensive anchors; AI/tech exposure via global names; domestic tech limited but Dalaroo rare earths support EV supply chain

key_themes: Higher-for-longer rates as structural norm (Bullock hawkish)
Iron ore structural demand risk from China slowdown
Housing market correction in Sydney and nationally
Gold and critical minerals exploration boom in WA/SA
Superannuation system reform and digital pension proposal
Trump-Xi geopolitical risk and trade policy uncertainty
Productivity growth concerns per Intergenerational Report

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA sustained hawkish policy / higher-for-longer rates
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds, quality dividend payers; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse from China economic weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPLs; underweight property REITs; favour defensive financials with strong capital buffers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel/energy price shock and inflation re-acceleration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities (WES.AX); avoid high-cost-of-living consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical risk: Trump-Xi summit, trade wars, global conflict
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain gold allocation; diversify away from China-exposed miners; hold quality defensives

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer spending deterioration and retail bankruptcies
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight discretionary consumer; favour staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) and healthcare (CSL.AX)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical minerals exploration names
opportunities.rationale: Active WA/SA drilling pipeline (10.72g/t Great Southern, Broken Hill sulphides, Larvotto antimony-gold, Dalaroo rare earths) signals sector rotation away from iron ore; gold hedges rate and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add LNG-exposed energy names on oil pullback
opportunities.rationale: Chevron/ExxonMobil LNG capex supercycle provides long-term revenue visibility; oil dip offers entry point

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight quality dividend financials and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Hawkish RBA supports NIMs; super contribution surge boosts fund managers; CSL.AX/SGH.AX offer defensive yield in volatile environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and China-exposed mining weightings
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside structural; China economic cracks and Trump trade policy create demand overhang

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property REITs and discretionary consumer
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney housing bloodbath, auction reality check, consumer weakness (Dollar General, Christmas retailer bankruptcy) signal prolonged softness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% gold allocation as macro hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate uncertainty, geopolitical risk, and currency volatility support gold; Bullock hawkishness limits bond yields

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1-3 months. Bullock hawkishness and iron ore weakness cap upside; Trump-Xi summit provides brief risk-on window. Housing stress and fuel shock weigh on sentiment. Expect 2-4% volatility around current levels.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if China stabilises and RBA pivots. Gold/critical minerals and LNG sectors offer structural growth. Housing correction may create value in quality REITs by H2 2027. Super reform and digital pension scheme could reshape financials sector. Productivity concerns cap earnings growth.
